_source: Single source of truth for the ElfKick web panel's control map. Authored Oct 30, 2026 by extracting the live sources (bridge.py tables, Kick/modules/contracts/dcl/dcl_contracts.h enums, build.py layout, template.html handlers, bridge.js forwarding); from then on it is hand-maintained and panel/test_controls.py fails the moment any of those sources and this file disagree. Pattern lifted from orrpunk-art/virtual-mpc-sample panel/controls.json (MIT) — see ../VIRTUAL_MPC_STUDY.md lift #1.
_comment: Frame = the CPktMgr frame the bridge must put on the pty wire. pkt_type/cmd are the PktMgr type and command bytes; wire framing (MT header, size, CRC-8, trailing newline) is bridge.py build_frame/send_hw. state = 1 pressed / 0 released. 'gap' marks every control that intentionally has no live frame, with the reason — an unmapped control WITHOUT a gap entry fails the selftest.

page.handler: jogStep(delta) — template.html (circular drag with 12-degree detent accumulator, wheel, [ ] keys, cursor-ring presses)

bridge.handler: on_web_message() 'jog' branch in bridge.py

frame.data_note: data[0] = EN_KNOB_CENTER (KnobSequence 0); direction 1=CW / 0=CCW; steps = min(|delta|, 8). This rotary shape is what the runtime's screens switch on (FileBrowser::handleCommand); the older EN_KNOB_CW/CCW detent BUTTON frames were retired Oct 30, 2026.

page.handler: jogPush(down) — template.html endDrag: press+release with zero detents emitted in between (sub-detent wiggle < 12 degrees still counts as a click; a drag that stepped never confirms)

bridge.handler: on_web_message() 'jogpush' branch in bridge.py

frame.data_note: Despite the name this is a BtnLedSequence code on a BUTTON frame, not a KNOBS message (DclContractsHelper::isCenterKnobClickMessage). Press and release both forwarded; screens act on BTN_PRESSED.

page_events_not_bridged.reason: template.html re-emits Web MIDI poly aftertouch as an MPC event; bridge.js deliberately does not forward it (logged as unhandled). No panel control produces it — it only exists for external MIDI controllers.

session_messages_not_controls.reason: bridge.js sends knob baselines on connect; bridge.py syncs Bridge.knob_last. Not a control.
Screen-stream subscription and its ack (bridge.js startScreen/stopScreen; bridge.py ScreenStreamer). Not a control.
LED feedback: bridge.py broadcasts {t:'led', id, on} from LED frames via LED_CODE_TO_PANEL; bridge.js applies MPC.setLed.
Pad feedback: bridge.py pad_light() -> {t:'padlight'}; bridge.js applies MPC.setPad.
Bridge log lines surfaced in the page console by bridge.js.
Bridge greeting sent on WS connect.
